L'oligodendroglioma (OMS 2021: IDH-mutat:
Oligodendroglioma (WHO 2021: IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, grade 2 or 3) is typically frontal, cortical-subcortical, with calcifications in 70-90% of cases (better seen on CT), heterogeneous signal and cystic components; enhancement is more frequent in grade 3. Compared with IDH-mutant astrocytoma it has a better prognosis and responds to chemotherapy (PCV, temozolomide).
